repo_notes: N-Zik is a multilingual fork of Kreate, built with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP).
Prioritize documentation for 'composeApp' (UI/Core), 'modules' (Shared Logic), and 'extensions' (Data Providers).
Tone: Technical yet pedagogical, suitable for contributors learning Kotlin/Compose.
Extensions are mapped in settings.gradle.kts and reside in 'extensions/' and 'modules/'.

Crowdin's GitHub integration uses crowdin.yml. Android reads the English XML catalogs from ComposeN-Zik/src/androidMain/localization/source/ and translations from localization/translations/<locale>/. Gradle generates the Android resource directories at build time.
EXCLUDE: Do not document Desktop-specific logic or VLCJ implementations (Desktop support is out of scope).
Highlight differences with the original Kreate fork where relevant.
